name: Makershelf
description: makershelf Server for Unraid — 3D print file and project manager for makers, workshops and teams. Organise models, track filament, manage your printer farm and maintenance schedules. Note: this is a beta release. Please report issues on GitHub. Before starting: install a PostgreSQL container from Community Apps (search "postgres"), create a database named "makershelf" with a dedicated user, then fill in the PostgreSQL Connection field below. On first launch, open the Web UI and follow the setup wizard to create your workspace and first admin account.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: AppData folder for configuration and runtime files.

paths.name: Project Storage
paths.description: Folder where imported project files are stored permanently.

paths.name: Import Folder
paths.description: Drop files or library folders here. The server scans this folder for bulk import without a browser upload.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the web interface. Leave as 8080 when using a dedicated container IP.

variables.name: Internal App Port
variables.description: Port the app listens on inside the container. Must match the Web UI Port when using a dedicated container IP.

variables.name: Session Secret
variables.description: Long random secret for login sessions. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

variables.name: PostgreSQL Connection
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Format: postgresql://user:password@host:5432/database — must match the credentials you set up in your PostgreSQL container.
